items.title: Physical Natural Gas Prices Diverge as Southern Heat Collides With Western Pullback
items.summary: Next-day natural gas spot prices popped in southern regions on Wednesday as strong cooling demand and steady LNG volumes squared off against solid production levels and moderating western weather.

items.title: Southern Heat Intensifies, Provides Natural Gas Futures Fresh Footing
items.summary: Natural gas futures advanced cautiously at midweek as bulls welcomed near-term cooling demand and the market overall braced for updated storage data that was projected to show supply abundance.

items.title: Transgaz Weighs Stake in Argent LNG as European Strategy Expands
items.summary: Argent LNG has added another potential European partner on its path to commercialization with a tentative deal with Romania’s Transgaz that could give the pipeline system operator an equity stake in the proposed 25 Mt/y Louisiana project.

items.title: As Forecasts Pile on CDDs, Natural Gas Futures Test 2-Week High
items.summary: Already-scorching weather models trended meaningfully hotter overnight while LNG feedgas flows bounced back from the previous session’s sharp decline, fueling double-digit week-to-date gains for prompt month futures.

items.title: Asia Pulling in More US LNG Amid Iran War, but Europe Still Top Destination
items.summary: The United States continues to send most of its LNG to Europe even though the Iran war has severely disrupted Asian supplies of the super-chilled fuel and sent prices there to multi-year highs.
